reason: The studio's category union and write-allowlist had no way to express or see a 'friction' artifact, so the surface simply could not represent the kind.
A shipped coverage command parses .tsx under ScriptKind.TS and returns the same understated count to every caller.
The ADR-NNNN token cannot distinguish a session-local allocate-late placeholder from the corpus's generic any-ADR pattern, so substitution cannot be targeted.
The existing `node build --real` verb writes over the launching session's presence declaration and flips it to done — an incorrect write every caller gets.
The spawned builders ended their turn before the gate work was complete, requiring an orchestrator nudge to resume.
A launch path that exists boots green and then 500s every API route with an error naming a workspace package rather than the missing loader — a misleading failure shipped to every caller.
The declared proof command exits 0 vacuously ('No projects matched the filters'), so the shipped CONFIRM_RED rung halts on a verdict that is wrong for anyone starting a story in a new package.
The .strict() wire schema cannot express an additive producer field, so the record type itself silently rejects the data it must carry.
No mechanism exists to re-validate a brief's negative existence premise against concurrent sibling landings, so the mandate was already discharged with nothing able to say so.
The shipped check:coverage rung validates a contract id against a test title rather than its clauses, returning the same over-claiming N/N to every caller.
The gate's ordering places the ten-second check:declared rung behind typecheck and the full test suite, so a shipped default forces a whole re-run for a trivial fix.
check:mirror-conformance exists but registers only one mirror, so the shipped fence returns a clean verdict on routes it never covers.
No claim or mutex mechanism exists for the friction queue at all, so concurrent adjudicator seats cannot be refused or even warned.
The shipped check:corpus-content ceiling is per-repo rather than per-author, so it attributes a sibling's live drift to whoever runs the gate.
An existing command fails to resolve the house @path convention and performs a wholesale destructive record write while reporting success.
The machine-scoped hook registration binds to whatever branch a host checkout happens to sit on, and the platform's silent non-blocking on hook failure is what makes the wall inert.
Node/pnpm/tsx module resolution from a directory outside the workspace is the cause, and it fails twice with messages naming neither resolution nor CJS transform.
The delivered sheet and its cells carry no per-cell record of the code state that produced them, so a two-variable comparison is indistinguishable from a one-variable one.
renderArcRollup's fixed ordering puts the only forward-looking section behind the entire increment log, so truncation silently removes it for every reader.
The shipped AUTHOR_TEST turn budget exhausted twice on a bounded two-file unit that a scoped worker proved immediately — a bad default in the build verb.
The probe's own stable-picture predicate ran but measured the wrong quantity, admitting frames whose visual inputs had changed.
The authoring session published a steering comparative without checking it against two artifacts already in the store that falsified both halves.
The lifecycle rule reads only the increment log, so work carried by a chip is a state the arc's record cannot see, and the arc auto-closed with its end state unmet.
The shipped check reports the routine 'stale' signature while already holding the budget fact, giving every caller a verdict whose documented remedy is wrong for this case.
No edge, tag, curator trigger or gate rung exists that can detect one ADR semantically falsifying another's build address.
gate:bg's detach is defeated for any caller who pipes its output, and the resulting death is silent and indistinguishable from the documented starvation case.
The pass's own verify.py check ran but asserted against the branch diff rather than the promise, so it reported a broken promise where there was none.
No kind-agnostic or field-agnostic text search over the corpus exists, so the absence sweep the task required cannot be performed at any reasonable cost.
The harness's shipped non-vacuity guard counts opaque pixels, a measure structurally incapable of moving when a prop disappears, and returns the same false clean verdict to every pass.
A Linux-CI-only rmdir race in a temp fixture teardown reddened CI on a branch touching nothing near it, and cleared on a bare re-run.
capture.mjs hardcodes a steady-state 30s goto budget with no override, so the first run in any fresh worktree refuses with a message naming the page rather than the cold transform.
Bun is installed on the dev box but absent from the shells' PATH, so the machine rather than the repository's code takes the gate red.
The shipped `uat run` path passes the observe runner unmemoized where `adopt` wraps it, so every caller re-runs the identical deterministic suite once per leg.
A shipped probe checks a retired invariant and fails a correctly-provisioned box, and its fix hint prescribes an action the onboarding guide forbids.
The shipped --rerun-failed comparison asserts 'nothing was fixed' from git alone, delivering the same confidently wrong verdict for every store-reading rung.
The session's own measurement instrument ran with its arguments in the wrong slots and published plausible numbers, so the check that ran was measuring the wrong thing.
The shipped rung's closing message names only two remedies and omits the correct third, steering every session it reds toward tests that cannot pass or a dead-code disable marker.
The measurement driver's default COMMITTED_RUNG builds a URL for an asset that was never committed, so the published reproduce command 404s for every fresh checkout.
A shipped gate rung reds on any fresh worktree regardless of branch content because its skip branch does not fire, reproducing even at origin/main.
A flag interaction re-arms the parked-entry fence against a documented --discharged-by exemption, and the refusal prints a remedy that would mint a second increment for landed work.
